title: Dive into Claude Code: The Design Space of Today's and Future AI Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2604.14228v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that can run shell commands, edit files, and call external services on behalf of the user. This study describes its architecture by analyzing the publicly available source code and comparing it with two independent open-source AI agent systems, OpenClaw and Hermes Agent, that answer many of similar or even the same design questions. Our analysis identifies five human values, philosophies, and needs that motivate the architecture: human decision authority, safety, security, and privacy, reliable execution, capability amplification, and contextual adaptability. We then trace them through thirteen design principles to implementation choices. The core of the system is a simple while-loop that calls the model, runs tools, and repeats. Most of the code, however, lives in the systems around this loop: a permission system with seven modes and an ML-based classifier, a five-layer compaction pipeline

translated_title: 深入解析Claude Code：当今与未来AI智能体系统的设计空间
translated_abstract: Claude Code是一个智能体编码工具，能够代表用户运行shell命令、编辑文件并调用外部服务。本研究通过分析其公开可用的源代码，并将其与两个独立的开源AI智能体系统OpenClaw和Hermes Agent进行对比（这两个系统回答了许多相似甚至相同的设计问题），从而描述了其架构。我们的分析识别出驱动该架构的五种人类价值观、理念与需求：人类决策权威、安全性、安保与隐私、可靠执行、能力放大以及情境适应性。随后，我们通过十三条设计原则将这些价值观追溯到具体的实现选择。系统的核心是一个简单的while循环：调用模型、运行工具、然后重复。然而，大部分代码存在于该循环周围的系统之中：一个拥有七种模式和基于机器学习分类器的权限系统，一个五层压缩流水线……
tldr: 该研究通过分析Claude Code源代码并与两个开源智能体系统对比，提炼出驱动其架构的五种人类价值观（人类决策权威、安全与隐私、可靠执行、能力放大、情境适应性）和十三条设计原则，揭示其核心仅是简单的while循环，而复杂性主要存在于循环周围的支撑系统中。
